name: Carbajales de Alba (Spain)
description: Five horizontal stripes of red, green, white, green and red with a double-width white stripe charged towards the hoist with a blue twelve-pointed star.
history: The full council of Carbajales de Alba, in ordinary session on 26 October 2001, agreed to approve the heraldic arms and municipal flag; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of five horizontal stripes in proportions 1/6, 1/6, 2/6, 1/6 and 1/6, red the upper and lower, green the intermediate ones and white with a blue twelve-pointed star at a third of the length of the flag the central one.

features.role: twelve-pointed star at a third of the length
